market.summary: India ignored the US and Asia sell-off: the Nifty rose 2% to above 25,000, its seventh straight gain and best week in six years, led by banks after record foreign buying. The rally was narrow, though: more stocks fell than rose, and smallcaps lost 0.8%. Your holdings are mostly not in the large-cap names that led it, so the index move overstates how well they did today. Crude easing helps your hotel names slightly.

points.text: Close 6 Nov: Nifty 25,030.35 (+2.01%), Sensex 81,028.02 (+2.17%); weekly gain about 8.6% for the Nifty.
Breadth was negative: 1,681 up, 2,400 down. Midcaps ended slightly lower and smallcaps fell 0.8%. Media, Energy and Realty lost 0.9-1.5%.
On 5 Nov FIIs bought about Rs 14,975 Cr while DIIs sold about Rs 10,445 Cr; FIIs have bought five days running, about Rs 35,800 Cr in that time. 6 Nov figures are not in yet.
Overnight on 5 Nov: S&P 500 -4.4%, Nasdaq -5.5%; the fear gauge VIX eased to about 25.5 on 6 Nov, from about 28.
Brent about $96.9, down 17.6% in five days; USD/INR about 93.9 (screener's readings at about 15:20 IST).
Nothing new on tariffs or Trump policy in the close report read; the US midterm result is cited as a sentiment factor.

SEJALLTD.summary: The board approved buying Magnumtuff's architectural and automotive glass business in Karnataka for Rs 40.80 Cr in cash, which would be Sejal's fourth plant. It is a small add: about 4% of the market cap, for a business with about Rs 36 Cr of yearly revenue against Sejal's Rs 138 Cr in the last quarter alone. It supports the growth story modestly but does not change the trade, which closed slightly under cost. I could not open the exchange filing; these details come from reports of it, and how the deal is funded and what the business earns are not stated.

points.text: Going-concern purchase of the business plus the factory land and building (about 6.8 acres) at Chikkodi, Belgaum, for Rs 40.80 Cr in cash; Magnumtuff's FY26 revenue was Rs 36.20 Cr.
Completion is targeted by 30 Nov 2026, the agreement is still to be signed, and the reports say it is not a related-party deal and needs no regulatory approval.
Close Rs 876.80 on 6 Nov (BSE; NSE did not answer tonight), -0.16R, slightly under your Rs 884.13 cost; stop Rs 838.03, +1R Rs 930.23.

SEJALLTD.watch: Signing by 30 Nov and how it is funded; a close under Rs 838.03 is the stop. The monthly RSI warning stays.
